# Medicine Visual Story

> An interactive, aggregate and anonymised visual exploration of community medicine redistribution and Pharma company donation records.

## Main page

- [Medicine Visual Story](/): Interactive two-stream dashboard, findings, methodology and visualization galleries.

## Downloads

- [All visualization PNGs](/medicine-visualizations.zip): Download the complete chart archive.
- [Pharma visualization PNGs](/pharma-visualizations.zip): Download the Pharma company chart archive.

## Topics

- Donation activity over time.
- Medicine frequency, quantity and recorded value.
- Donor and receiver diagnosis distributions.
- Shelf-life and expiry analysis.
- Pazopanib and Votrient brand comparisons.
- Data-quality indicators.
- Pharma company concentration, medicine allocation and quantity-unit analysis.

## Usage

The website presents descriptive programme data. It does not provide medical advice or clinical treatment recommendations.
